description.value: Ricky's Country Restaurant (Schoolhouse) is a full-service family dining chain location in Coquitlam with over 60 years of brand history, offering all-day breakfast, lunch, and dinner. The restaurant features a private dining room, takeout, and delivery, and is part of a 85+ location Canadian chain known for its breakfast specials, Canadian Angus beef burgers, and comfort food classics. Touring cyclists will find a sit-down meal with a broad menu and the option to order online or take food to go.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for the Schoolhouse location confirms the address (#300, 100 Schoolhouse Street, Coquitlam, BC, V3K 6V9), phone (604-526-2272), and active operations with dining room, online ordering, takeout, and delivery. No mention of bike-specific infrastructure anywhere in the website content, so all bike/cycling amenity fields are null. The OSM name 'Ricky's Country Restaurant' differs slightly from the website page title 'Schoolhouse - Rickys Grill', which is consistent with Ricky's operating under the 'Ricky's All Day Grill' brand; this is flagged as a minor concern.
concerns: OSM name is 'Ricky's Country Restaurant' but the website page title reads 'Schoolhouse - Rickys Grill' and the brand is consistently referred to as 'Ricky's All Day Grill' — the OSM name may be outdated or reflect an older branding (pre-ABC Country Restaurant merger era).
OSM address field omits unit number; website confirms the unit is #300.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible full-service restaurant confirmed active by website with current hours and services listed.
